signature-journey.lead: A comprehensive 10-day journey showcasing the best of Sri Lanka's culture, nature, wildlife, and coastal beauty.
signature-journey.bookLabel: Reserve This Journey or Let Us Tailor It
signature-journey.reviewsTitle: What Guests Thought About This Journey

reviews.quote: This journey was the perfect introduction to Sri Lanka. We experienced everything from ancient temples in Kandy to tea plantations in Nuwara Eliya, wildlife in Yala, and beautiful beaches. The itinerary was perfectly balanced, and our chauffeur made every day smooth and enjoyable.
reviews.author: Sarah & James W, Australia

reviews.quote: The Signature Journey exceeded our expectations. We loved the variety—cultural sites, wildlife safaris, scenic train rides, and beach time. Every detail was thoughtfully planned, and we never felt rushed. The hotels were excellent, and our driver was knowledgeable and friendly throughout.
reviews.author: Thomas & Maria L, Germany

reviews.quote: From Sigiriya's ancient rock fortress to the tea plantations and Yala's wildlife, this journey covered all of Sri Lanka's highlights beautifully. The pace was perfect, allowing us to truly experience each place without feeling rushed. Our chauffeur's local knowledge made every stop more meaningful.
reviews.author: Rachel & Ben C, New Zealand

reviews.quote: What impressed us most was how seamlessly everything flowed—from cultural sites to nature to relaxation. The hotels were carefully selected, the timing was perfect, and we never had to worry about logistics. It truly felt like a bespoke experience tailored just for us.
reviews.author: Luca & Francesca M, Italy

days.title: Arrival in Colombo
body: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you'll be greeted by your private chauffeur-guide and transferred to your hotel in Colombo.
highlights: Evening at leisure to recover from your journey
Optional: Brief city tour of Colombo

days.title: Colombo to Sigiriya
body: After breakfast, journey to the Cultural Triangle. Visit the ancient rock fortress of Sigiriya, a UNESCO World Heritage site rising 200 meters above the surrounding plains.
highlights: Scenic drive through rural Sri Lanka
Explore ancient frescoes and water gardens
days.alt: Sigiriya Rock Fortress in Sri Lanka

days.title: Cultural Triangle Exploration
body: Discover the ancient cities of Polonnaruwa and Anuradhapura. Explore well-preserved ruins, massive stupas, and intricate stone carvings that tell the story of ancient Sri Lankan civilization.
days.alt: Cultural Triangle ruins in Sri Lanka

days.title: Sigiriya to Kandy
body: Travel to the hill capital of Kandy, home to the Temple of the Tooth Relic. En route, visit a spice garden to learn about Sri Lankan spices and traditional medicine.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
body: Journey into the tea country, ascending through misty hills and emerald-green tea plantations. Visit a working tea factory and enjoy a cup of freshly brewed Ceylon tea.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Yala
body: Descend from the hills to the wildlife-rich plains of Yala National Park. Check into your safari lodge and prepare for an early morning game drive.
days.alt: Yala National Park in Sri Lanka

days.title: Yala Wildlife Safari
body: Early morning and evening game drives in Yala National Park, one of the best places in the world to spot leopards. The park is also home to elephants, sloth bears, and diverse birdlife.

days.title: Yala to Galle / Mirissa
body: Travel to the southern coast, stopping at the historic Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Continue to the beach town of Mirissa for relaxation and coastal beauty.

days.title: Coastal Relaxation
body: A day to unwind on the beautiful beaches of Mirissa. Optional activities include whale watching (seasonal), surfing, or simply enjoying the golden sands and turquoise waters.

days.title: Departure
body: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure flight, taking with you unforgettable memories of your Signature Sri Lanka Journey.

hill-country-journey.lead: A 8-day journey through Sri Lanka's misty highlands, featuring the world's most scenic train ride, tea plantations, and the cool climate of hill country towns.
hill-country-journey.bookLabel: Reserve This Journey or Let Us Tailor It
hill-country-journey.reviewsTitle: What Guests Thought About This Journey

reviews.quote: The scenic train journey from Kandy to Ella was absolutely breathtaking. Rolling through tea plantations with misty mountains all around—it was like something from a postcard. The hill country towns were charming, and the cool climate was a welcome change from the coast.
reviews.author: Robert & Anna H, Sweden

reviews.quote: We loved exploring the tea plantations and learning about Ceylon tea. Nuwara Eliya felt like a different world with its colonial architecture and cool mountain air. The train ride was definitely a highlight—one of the most beautiful journeys we've ever taken.
reviews.author: Yuki & Hiroshi T, Japan

reviews.quote: The hill country exceeded all our expectations. The tea factory tour was fascinating, and the views from the train were absolutely stunning. Ella's Nine Arch Bridge was a photographer's dream, and the cool mountain air was so refreshing after the coastal heat.
reviews.author: Daniel & Emma S, Switzerland

reviews.quote: Perfect for those who love mountains and trains! The journey through the hill country was peaceful and beautiful. We especially enjoyed the tea tasting sessions and the charming guesthouses. It felt like stepping back in time while enjoying modern comforts.
reviews.author: Hans & Ingrid V, Norway

days.title: Arrival & Transfer to Kandy
body: Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport and meet your private chauffeur-guide. Travel at a relaxed pace to Kandy and check into your hotel overlooking the lake. The remainder of the day is free to rest and unwind.

days.title: Kandy Culture & Relaxation
body: Explore Kandy at an easy pace. Visit the Temple of the Tooth Relic, enjoy a walk around Kandy Lake, and explore the Royal Botanical Gardens. Return to your hotel in the afternoon for rest or relaxation.

days.title: Scenic Train Journey to Nuwara Eliya
body: Board the scenic hill-country train from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya, passing tea estates, misty mountains, and waterfalls. On arrival, your chauffeur will meet you and transfer you to your hotel.
days.alt: Scenic train through Sri Lanka hill country

days.title: Nuwara Eliya
body: Enjoy a relaxed day in Nuwara Eliya. Visit a tea factory, stroll around Gregory Lake, and explore the town’s colonial charm. The afternoon is free to rest or enjoy the cool mountain climate.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Ella
body: Travel through scenic hill-country landscapes to Ella. Visit the famous Nine Arch Bridge and settle into your hotel surrounded by mountain views.

days.title: Ella at Leisure
body: A full day to enjoy Ella at your own pace. Optional visits include Little Adam’s Peak or Ravana Falls. Spend the remainder of the day relaxing or exploring the town.

days.title: Ella to West Coast / Near Airport
body: After breakfast, depart Ella and travel towards the west coast. Enjoy a comfortable drive through changing landscapes and check into your hotel near the coast. Evening at leisure.

days.title: Departure
body: After breakfast, enjoy a short and smooth transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

nature-wildlife-journey.lead: An immersive 9-day adventure focusing on Sri Lanka's incredible biodiversity, from leopards and elephants to diverse birdlife and pristine natural habitats.
nature-wildlife-journey.bookLabel: Reserve This Journey or Let Us Tailor It
nature-wildlife-journey.reviewsTitle: What Guests Thought About This Journey

reviews.quote: As wildlife enthusiasts, this journey was a dream come true. We saw leopards in Yala, elephants in Udawalawe, and so many birds. The early morning safaris were magical, and our guide's knowledge of the animals and their behavior made each game drive unforgettable.
reviews.author: David & Lisa K, Canada

reviews.quote: The wildlife encounters exceeded all our expectations. From spotting a leopard with cubs to watching elephants bathe, every moment was incredible. The parks were well-chosen, and the timing of the safaris was perfect for seeing the most activity.
reviews.author: Sophie M, France

reviews.quote: We've been on safaris in Africa, but Sri Lanka's wildlife parks offered something completely unique. The diversity of species, from sloth bears to leopards to countless birds, was remarkable. Our chauffeur knew exactly where to go and when, maximizing our chances of incredible sightings.
reviews.author: Alexandra & Peter F, South Africa

reviews.quote: The bird watching was exceptional—we spotted over 50 different species. But the highlight was definitely seeing a leopard in Yala and a family of elephants in Udawalawe. The early morning safaris were worth every moment, and the naturalists' expertise added so much to the experience.
reviews.author: Marcus & Julia N, Netherlands

days.title: Arrival in Sri Lanka & Overnight Near Airport
body: Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private chauffeur-guide. After assistance with arrival formalities, transfer to a comfortable hotel near the airport or along the west coast to rest and recover from your international journey.
highlights: Overnight near airport for a smooth start

days.title: Transfer to Yala National Park
body: After breakfast, depart towards Yala National Park, traveling through changing landscapes from coastal plains to dry-zone wilderness. Upon arrival, check into your safari lodge and enjoy time at leisure before your wildlife adventure begins.
highlights: Scenic drive to Yala National Park

days.title: Yala National Park | Full-Day Safari
body: Spend the day exploring Yala National Park, renowned for having one of the highest leopard densities in the world. Enjoy early morning and afternoon game drives led by experienced trackers, with opportunities to spot elephants, sloth bears, crocodiles, and diverse birdlife.

days.title: Yala to Udawalawe National Park
body: Travel onward to Udawalawe National Park, famous for its large elephant population and open grasslands that provide excellent wildlife viewing opportunities. En route, visit the Udawalawe Elephant Transit Home.
days.alt: Udawalawe National Park in Sri Lanka

days.title: Udawalawe to Sinharaja Rainforest
body: Journey towards the lush rainforests of Sinharaja, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Sri Lanka’s richest biodiversity zones. Upon arrival, check into your rainforest lodge and enjoy a gentle evening nature walk.

days.title: Sinharaja Rainforest Exploration
body: Explore Sinharaja with an expert naturalist guide. Trek through dense rainforest trails, search for endemic bird species, observe rare flora, and visit hidden waterfalls. Activities are paced according to forest conditions.

days.title: Sinharaja to Wilpattu National Park
body: Depart Sinharaja and travel north to Wilpattu National Park, Sri Lanka’s largest and oldest national park. Known for its natural villus (lakes), Wilpattu offers a quieter and more secluded safari experience. Check in and enjoy an evening game drive.
days.alt: Wilpattu National Park in Sri Lanka

days.title: Wilpattu Safari & Transfer to West Coast
body: Enjoy an early morning safari in Wilpattu, searching for leopards, sloth bears, and other wildlife around the park’s villus. After a relaxed breakfast, begin your journey back towards the west coast for a comfortable overnight stay near the airport.
highlights: Scenic transfer to the west coast
Overnight stay near the airport for a relaxed departure the next day
days.alt: Journey to the west coast of Sri Lanka

days.title: Departure
body: After breakfast, enjoy a smooth transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport for your departure flight. Your chauffeur-guide will assist with drop-off arrangements, concluding your Nature & Wildlife Discovery Journey with ease.

coastal-retreat-journey.lead: A relaxing 8-day coastal escape exploring Sri Lanka's stunning beaches, from the historic Galle Fort to pristine bays perfect for swimming, surfing, and sunset watching.
coastal-retreat-journey.bookLabel: Reserve This Journey or Let Us Tailor It
coastal-retreat-journey.reviewsTitle: What Guests Thought About This Journey

reviews.quote: The coastal journey was exactly what we needed—pure relaxation. The beaches were stunning, the seafood was incredible, and we loved the laid-back atmosphere. Whale watching was a highlight, and the sunsets were absolutely magical every evening.
reviews.author: Charlotte & Mark B, United Kingdom

reviews.quote: Perfect for beach lovers! We spent our days swimming, surfing, and just soaking up the sun. The coastal towns had great restaurants, and the people were so friendly. It was the perfect way to unwind and recharge.
reviews.author: Carlos & Elena R, Spain

reviews.quote: Galle Fort was a wonderful surprise—such a beautiful blend of history and modern cafes. The beaches at Mirissa and Unawatuna were pristine, and we loved the fresh seafood everywhere. This journey was pure relaxation from start to finish.
reviews.author: Sophie & Pierre D, Belgium

reviews.quote: We came for the beaches and stayed for everything else. The coastal drive was scenic, the beachfront hotels were perfect, and the water was warm and inviting. Surfing lessons in Arugam Bay were a highlight, and the local food was incredible.
reviews.author: Mike & Sarah J, United States

days.title: Arrival & Transfer to Arugam Bay
body: Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport and meet your private chauffeur-guide. Begin the cross-island journey to Arugam Bay, passing changing landscapes. Upon arrival, check in and enjoy a relaxed evening to recover from your travel day.

days.title: Arugam Bay – Surf & Beach Day
body: A full day to enjoy Arugam Bay at your own pace. Spend time on the beach, try surfing with optional lessons, and enjoy the relaxed coastal atmosphere.
days.alt: Surfing at Arugam Bay, Sri Lanka

days.title: Arugam Bay – Leisure Day
body: Another relaxed day on the east coast. Enjoy slow beach time, swimming, or take an optional lagoon or village visit nearby. The day remains flexible and unhurried.
days.alt: Arugam Bay beach in Sri Lanka

days.title: Arugam Bay to Mirissa
body: Depart Arugam Bay early and travel to the south coast. Arrive in Mirissa by afternoon and settle into your beachfront stay. Enjoy a calm evening by the sea.

days.title: Mirissa – Beach & Optional Whale Watching
body: A relaxed day in Mirissa. Optional whale watching is available seasonally (November to April). Otherwise, enjoy beach time, swimming, or local cafés.

days.title: Mirissa to Galle
body: After breakfast, enjoy a short coastal drive to Galle. Check in and explore the historic fort area at a relaxed pace.

days.title: Galle Fort – Leisure Day
body: A full relaxed day in Galle Fort. Walk the ramparts, browse boutiques, enjoy cafés, and soak in the coastal atmosphere.

days.title: Departure
body: After breakfast, transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport for your departure flight.
